title: Blood Sugar Sex Magik
notes:
Weight of each record around 110 to 115 grams. 

Released with two printed inner sleeves including band pics and lyrics.
"Suck My Kiss" misspelled "Suck Me Kiss" on label.

Published by Moebetoblame Music (BMI), 
except "They're Red Hot" published by King Of Spades Music (BMI). 
 
©℗ 1991 Warner Bros. Records, Inc. for the U.S. and 
WEA International Inc. for the world outside of the U.S.

Made in Germany by Warner Music Manufacturing Europe

Dedicated to [a=Mike Watt].

Runouts:
"WMME Alsdorf 759 926681-1-A", "WMME Alsdorf 759 926681-1-B", "WMME Alsdorf 759 926681-1-C" and "WMME Alsdorf 759 926681-1-D" are stamped, the rest is etched.

Some front sleeves had sticker stating, 'CONTAINS LANGUAGE THAT SOME PEOPLE MAY FIND OFFENSIVE'
